## Spec

A component writes this trait's fields under `spec.sidecarContainers`.

```cue
spec: sidecarContainers: [...#SidecarContainersSchema]

// Sidecar container shape — alias of #ContainerSchema.
#SidecarContainersSchema: res.#ContainerSchema
```

Defined elsewhere:

- `res.#ContainerSchema`: the spec of [Container](/docs/reference/catalog-members/resources/container/)
